description: FDW/SERVER/FOREIGN TABLE/USER MAPPING/IMPORT acceptance on postgresql17 (#127): postgres_fdw self-connections prove the full foreign-data lifecycle end to end.

ddl_steps.name: create extension fdw
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE EXTENSION postgres_fdw

ddl_steps.name: create schema
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE SCHEMA t44

ddl_steps.name: local source table
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE TABLE t44.local_src (id int PRIMARY KEY, v text); INSERT INTO t44.local_src VALUES (1,'a')

ddl_steps.name: create server self
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE SERVER t44_self FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER postgres_fdw OPTIONS (host 'localhost', port '5432', dbname 'postgres')

ddl_steps.name: alter server options
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER SERVER t44_self OPTIONS (ADD use_remote_estimate 'true')

ddl_steps.name: alter server version/rename/owner
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER SERVER t44_self VERSION '17'; ALTER SERVER t44_self RENAME TO t44_self2

ddl_steps.name: create user mapping
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE USER MAPPING FOR postgres SERVER t44_self2 OPTIONS (user 'postgres')

ddl_steps.name: create user mapping public
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE USER MAPPING FOR PUBLIC SERVER t44_self2

ddl_steps.name: alter user mapping
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER USER MAPPING FOR postgres SERVER t44_self2 OPTIONS (SET user 'postgres')

ddl_steps.name: create foreign table
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE FOREIGN TABLE t44.ft (id int, v text) SERVER t44_self2 OPTIONS (schema_name 't44', table_name 'local_src')

ddl_steps.name: select foreign table
ddl_steps.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t44.ft

verify.sql: SELECT v FROM t44.ft WHERE id=1

ddl_steps.name: alter foreign table add col
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER FOREIGN TABLE t44.ft ADD COLUMN w text

ddl_steps.name: alter foreign table rename/schema
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER FOREIGN TABLE t44.ft RENAME TO ft2; ALTER FOREIGN TABLE t44.ft2 SET SCHEMA public

ddl_steps.name: alter foreign table options
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER FOREIGN TABLE public.ft2 OPTIONS (ADD fetch_size '1000')

ddl_steps.name: import foreign schema
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE SCHEMA t44_imp; IMPORT FOREIGN SCHEMA t44 LIMIT TO (local_src) FROM SERVER t44_self2 INTO t44_imp

ddl_steps.name: import except
ddl_steps.sql: IMPORT FOREIGN SCHEMA t44 EXCEPT (local_src) FROM SERVER t44_self2 INTO public

ddl_steps.name: drop user mapping
ddl_steps.sql: DROP USER MAPPING IF EXISTS FOR postgres SERVER t44_self2; DROP USER MAPPING IF EXISTS FOR PUBLIC SERVER t44_self2

ddl_steps.name: drop foreign table
ddl_steps.sql: DROP FOREIGN TABLE IF EXISTS public.ft2 CASCADE; DROP TABLE t44.local_src

ddl_steps.name: drop server
ddl_steps.sql: DROP SERVER IF EXISTS t44_self2 CASCADE

ddl_steps.name: alter fdw options
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER postgres_fdw OPTIONS (ADD extension_control 'x')

ddl_steps.name: alter fdw rename/owner
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER postgres_fdw RENAME TO t44_fdw; ALTER FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER t44_fdw RENAME TO postgres_fdw

ddl_steps.name: drop schema+ext
ddl_steps.sql: DROP SCHEMA t44 CASCADE; DROP EXTENSION postgres_fdw

ddl_steps.name: drop fdw guarded
ddl_steps.sql: DROP FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER IF EXISTS t44_fdw CASCADE
